packs.title: Pura Luhur Uluwatu, Bali: Cliffside Sea Temple — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Pura Luhur Uluwatu is a Sad Kahyangan sea temple on a 70 m limestone cliff in Pecatu, South Kuta. Open daily 07:00–19:00 WITA. Paid entry at the official booth.

packs.title: Uluwatu Temple Opening Hours and IDR Fares — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Uluwatu Temple opens daily 07:00–19:00 WITA. Paid entry at the official booth: international adult/child IDR 60,000/40,000, domestic 40,000/30,000; fares can change.

packs.title: What to Wear at Uluwatu Temple: Sarong, Sash — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Sarong and sash are required at Uluwatu Temple and provided at the entrance. Cover shoulders and knees, respect restricted inner areas, and watch for monkeys.

packs.title: Uluwatu Temple: Kuta and Airport Drive Times — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Uluwatu Temple is about 30 km from Denpasar: roughly 45 minutes from Kuta or Seminyak, 45 minutes to an hour from the airport, and 1.5–2 hours from Ubud.

packs.title: Uluwatu Temple Best Time for Kecak: Before 17:00 — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Uluwatu Temple is open daily 07:00–19:00 WITA. For Kecak, the gate opens at 16:00 and the show runs 18:00–19:00; arrive at the temple before 17:00.
keywords: best time to visit Uluwatu Temple

packs.title: Uluwatu Temple Notes: Monkeys, Cliffs, Cash — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Uluwatu Temple notes: modest dress, sarong and sash at the entrance, monkey precautions, cliff safety, and cash for the separately ticketed Kecak show.

packs.title: Uluwatu Temple on Foot: Six Stops to Kecak — SanctaWay
packs.meta: Uluwatu Temple on foot: main gate and official ticket booth, sacred forest, cliffside pathways, temple history, restricted inner shrine, and Kecak amphitheatre.
